key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks
AUD smashed on growth scare; iron ore entering 'bloodletting' phase
RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate path
Oil prices exploded as OPEC+ suppression failed; Australian fuel prices set to rise 30c
ANZ announced 3,500 job cuts amid restructuring; banks under pressure from rising bond yields
Housing market weak: no spring bounce at auctions, prices crashing, first-home buyers surging
Australia softened local gas supply rules, easing Asian energy fears; Santos preservation noted
Mining cap-raise activity surging (Canaccord-led), signalling sector stress
Woolworths breached 'Price Freeze' on four staples, reigniting cost-of-living concerns
Fed outlook clarity (higher-for-longer) reinforced global rate pressure

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; ASX miners led the $90bn weekly sell-off. Cap-raise activity surging (Canaccord-led) signals balance-sheet stress. Small-caps (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) showing relative strength.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from falling iron ore. Gold (60) underperforming. Battery/energy-transition names (Critical Resources) holding firm as structural tailwind. Avoid large-cap iron ore short-term; watch small-cap miners for volatility.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and rate fears pressured bank valuations. ANZ cut 3,500 jobs in restructuring. Net interest margin pressure from RBA's rental-inflation focus complicates easing expectations.
sectors.implications: ANZ.AX restructuring may support medium-term EPS but signals demand weakness. CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX face headwinds from higher funding costs. Monitor RBA commentary on rental inflation for rate-path clarity.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-positive for producers, negative for consumers. Oil surged as suppression failed; Australia softened gas supply rules easing Asian fears. Santos preservation noted as strategic priority. Fuel prices rising 30c.
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX) and Woodside (WDS.AX) benefit from gas policy flexibility. Oil spike pressures Qantas (QAN.AX) and airlines. Higher fuel costs feed into CPI, complicating RBA path.

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths breached its own 'Price Freeze' on staples. Fuel price rise adds to cost-of-living pressure. Business confidence deteriorating.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin squeeze from input costs vs. pricing power limits. Consumer discretionary names vulnerable. Defensive positioning in staples warranted.

sectors.trend: Negative. No spring bounce at auctions; housing prices crashing; first-home buyers surging on affordability. RBA watching rental inflation. NZ correction still running.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face rental-yield compression risk. Home-loan growth may slow. Falling prices benefit first-home buyers but signal broader demand weakness. Monitor RBA rental data closely.

sectors.trend: Neutral-to-positive. Limited ASX-specific news. Critical Resources battery tech holding firm. Global tech (AI slowdown calls, Palantir deals) provides mixed signals. Superannuation reform debate ongoing.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX relatively insulated from rate/commodity shocks. Superannuation policy risk (45, 54, 67) could affect fund flows. Battery/energy-storage names offer thematic exposure.

key_themes: Oil price surge and fuel cost inflation pressuring RBA rate path
Iron ore downturn hitting ASX materials sector hard
AUD weakness on growth scare; commodity-linked currency under pressure
Housing market correction accelerating; RBA rental inflation focus
Mining sector cap-raise wave signalling balance-sheet stress
Superannuation policy debate creating political and market uncertainty
Global rate environment (Fed higher-for-longer) constraining ASX valuations
Energy policy shift (gas supply rules) supporting domestic producers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike driving inflation and rate expectations higher
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour domestic gas producers (STO.AX, WDS.AX) over oil-import-dependent sectors. Monitor OPEC+ output decisions.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price decline compressing mining margins
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce large-cap iron ore exposure (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX); rotate into gold, battery metals, or energy-transition names.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA forced to hold rates higher due to rental and fuel inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour short-duration bonds; underweight rate-sensitive REITs and property developers. Monitor RBA rental data releases.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD weakness and growth scare triggering capital outflows
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify into USD-hedged exposures; monitor AUD/USD for 0.62 support. Exporters benefit from weaker AUD.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction deepening, threatening bank loan books
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor NIM and credit-loss provisions at CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX. Underweight residential REITs.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mining cap-raise dilution and small-cap volatility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid speculative small-cap miners; favour well-funded majors or battery/energy-storage names with clear offtake.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight domestic gas/energy producers on policy tailwind
opportunities.rationale: Australia softened gas supply rules easing Asian fears; Santos preservation signals strategic support. Oil surge lifts upstream earnings.

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into battery/energy-storage and critical minerals
opportunities.rationale: Critical Resources battery tech holding firm in testing; structural demand for energy transition metals offsets iron ore weakness.
CSL and healthcare names insulated from commodity/rate shocks; superannuation flows provide steady demand.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce large-cap iron ore and bank exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting and rising bond yields pressure both sectors. ANZ restructuring signals demand weakness.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight residential REITs and property developers
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing prices crashing, no auction bounce, RBA watching rental inflation. Credit risk building in loan books.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness and fuel-cost inflation
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; 30c fuel rise feeds CPI. Airlines and consumer staples face margin pressure.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to consolidate lower as oil-driven inflation keeps RBA on hold or hawkish. Iron ore weakness and AUD pressure cap upside. Expect volatility around RBA commentary and US Fed data. Key support for S&P/ASX 200 near recent lows; a break could trigger further $20-30bn outflows.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction may stabilise by H2 2027. Energy policy shifts support domestic producers. Battery/energy-transition theme offers structural growth. However, sustained high rates and weak iron ore cap earnings growth. Superannuation reform could redirect flows.

ANZ.AX, CBA.AX NIM and credit-loss trends
